data.desc: Silvercrest Asset Management Group LLC (the 'firm') is the principal operating subsidiary of Silvercrest Asset Management Group Inc. Silvercrest was founded in April 2002 as an independent, employee-owned registered investment adviser, headquartered in New York. The firm has seven additional offices in the United States, an office in Singapore, and team members based in Europe and Australia. The firm has opened its Dublin office as its first European base of operations to support existing clients across the EU. As of June 30, 2026, the firm reported discretionary assets under management of $24.7 billion.
